_comment: Demo dental clinic configuration for the investor demonstration and for
end-to-end tests. Content only — no schema is implied. Whoever seeds this
goes through the normal onboarding commands, not direct inserts.
The clinic, doctors and patients here are fictional. Replace with a real
design partner's configuration as soon as one is signed; the point of the
demo is that the agent handles a real clinic's rules, and real clinics have
rules nobody invents (the 3pm lab pickup, the Saturday half-day).
Durations are the appointment slot, not chair time. They include the
handover gap a receptionist leaves between patients.

spoken_name.note: Owners often want the English brand name kept in Tamil speech rather than translated. Confirm during onboarding; do not assume.

services.name: Root canal treatment
services.price_note: Per sitting. Usually two or three sittings — quote per sitting, never a total.

operating_schedule._comment: The split shift is the norm for Indian clinics and is the single most common thing a naive booking agent gets wrong — it offers 3pm, the clinic is shut, the patient shows up to a locked door. Any demo that only tests continuous hours has not tested anything.

owner.name: Dr. Rajesh Kumar
owner._comment: The owner is also a practising dentist. This is the normal case in an independent clinic and it matters: he sends WhatsApp messages between patients, in short bursts, often mid-treatment. Expect terse input and long silences, not tidy conversations.

policies.emergency_handling: Pain, swelling, bleeding, or trauma is not booked as a routine slot — the agent takes a callback number and tells the caller the clinic will ring back. It must never advise, triage, or estimate severity.
